rules.statement: A deed of transfer cannot be validly executed as a sale if there is no mutual agreement between the parties, and even if it is drafted as a sale, its validity depends on whether it was intended to be operative.
rules.supporting_quote: "In a contract of sale there must be complete agreement as regards the nature of the transaction, the thing sold and the price (consensus, res or merx et pretium) (Voet XVIII. 1.1.) .... The parties must mutually agree that the one is to sell and the other is to buy .... It is not enough that the parties call the transaction a sale ; the circumstances must show that the parties in reality entered into a true contract of sale".
